key_insight: CoDecoder pairs a small neural frontend with an unchanged quantum error decoder to improve accuracy while accelerating mean decoding time.
engineering_relevance: Confidence-based routing and fused GPU inference offer a practical way to accelerate existing quantum error-correction pipelines without replacing their decoders.
method: Predict each shot’s logical outcome, retain confident predictions, and route uncertain shots to a fallback decoder.
Use logical-operator-aware scoring: combine equivalent logical lines for surface codes and jointly decide logical qubits for BB codes.
Reduce per-shot overhead with fused GPU inference and efficient routing.
evidence_signal: Registered circuit-level-noise tests on distance-7–17 surface codes and two BB codes reported 6.4–50% fewer failures and 2.3–124× speed-ups versus the respective conventional fallback decoders.
watch_item: Reported speed-ups concern mean decoding time; real-time deployment also needs validation of tail latency and routing overhead on target hardware.
paper_title: CoDecoder: Make Quantum Decoders Up to 100x Faster and Even More Accurate
